70.DSCR:
An organization dedicated to annihilating the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, headquartered in the colony '$$アヴァロン$$', which is located far from Earth.
It has no such things as culture or family, and has a social structure that pursues thoroughgoing rationality and efficiency.
70.DSC2:
An organization dedicated to annihilating the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, headquartered in the colony '$$アヴァロン$$', which is located far from Earth.
It has no such things as culture or family, and has a social structure that pursues thoroughgoing rationality and efficiency.
Its ancestors were humans who set out from an Earth whose environment had changed drastically, and it had been in a position of opposition, since the time on Earth, to the organization '$$イボルバー$$', which tried to adapt to outer space by modifying humans... in other words, to the ancestors of the '$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$'.

71.DSCR:
A $$聖天翅$$ of the $$堕天翅$$ tribe, and a frontline commander who leads the $$天翅$$s.
Although he has wings on the back of his head, in every other respect he has the appearance closest to a human among the $$堕天翅$$.
Twelve thousand years ago, he was betrothed to $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the strongest of the $$守護天翅$$s. But at the end of the $$アトランディア大戦$$, $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ betrayed the $$堕天翅$$ tribe, and they crossed blades as enemies. Even so, that love had still not faded, and he approached $$アポロ$$, apparently the reincarnation of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, again and again.
In the course of the fighting he killed $$アポロ$$'s close friend $$バロン$$, and tormented $$アポロ$$ and the others by every means, such as cunningly tempting $$シリウス$$ into switching sides. But when the $$生命の樹$$ withered and the world faced the crisis of its end, he even teleported to $$ベクタールナ$$ to try to stop it. Even then he remained out of step with $$アポロ$$ and $$シリウス$$, but through the memories of $$セリアン$$ that $$シルヴィア$$ showed, he learned that $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ of long ago had not betrayed them but had wished for coexistence between the $$天翅$$s and humans. Once his resolve to carry on $$アポロニアス#pilot$$'s will was firm, the three of them succeeded in $$創聖合体$$ and held the shattering world together.

proofread.reason: wrong pronoun: the Head Wing (Toma) is male per the glossary research (work/glossary/research/aquarion.json 頭翅#pilot: MALE; the Japanese is gender-neutral); all she/her changed to he/his; 'his reincarnation' and 'his will' (Apollonius's) now name Apollonius by token to avoid a wrong referent after the pronoun change

72.DSCR:
The whole area around the equator of the Pacific Ocean on $$翠の地球$$.
Its distinguishing feature is that the color of the sea is green.

73.DSCR:
The ability to run one's motor skills, thought and reflexes at ten times ordinary human speed.
It lasts only about ten seconds, however, and cannot be used repeatedly.
What triggers the ability is unknown, though touching $$ジェニオン$$'s operating manual is thought to have set it off.
73.DSC2:
The ability to run one's motor skills, thought and reflexes at ten times ordinary human speed.
It lasts only about ten seconds, however, and cannot be used repeatedly.
What triggers the ability is unknown, though touching $$ジェニオン$$'s operating manual is thought to have set it off.
It later became clear that the ability had manifested through contact with the '$$黒の英知$$'.

74.DSCR:
The energy researched by Dr. $$千葉#macross$$, a military doctor of the Unified Forces in the $$マクロス７船団$$.
It is a theory advocating the effects of the waves carried by the songs that people sing, and it was proven through the treatment of people who had lost $$スピリチア$$ to the $$プロトデビルン$$ and through the development of a $$歌エネルギー|lc$$ conversion system.
The amount of energy is expressed in a unit called the '$$チバソング$$'. The $$歌エネルギー|lc$$ of an ordinary person is about 100 $$チバソング$$s, and even an excellent singer is said to be limited to about 1000 $$チバソング$$s.

75.DSCR:
Her full name is $$柏葉真紀$$.
A nurse working at $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
She is in charge of the patients with '$$血塗られた眼$$' who are hospitalized in the special ward.
A cheerful woman who looks after others well and is also capable of delicate consideration, she continues to nurse with devotion even the patients, who show almost no emotion.
After $$時空修復$$, she hopes for the recovery of the patients, whose fits have subsided.
75.DSC2:
A nurse working at $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
She is in charge of the patients with '$$血塗られた眼$$' who are hospitalized in the special ward.
A cheerful woman who looks after others well and is also capable of delicate consideration, she continues to nurse with devotion even the patients, who show almost no emotion.
During the fighting against $$サイデリアル$$, she thought there was something she could do too, volunteered as a nursing soldier, and went to the battlefield.
While a nurse, she is also a member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists' Action Unit, and like the other members she places blind trust in the unit's captain, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.
However, she could no longer tell whether that trust was her own will or mental control by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and in the end her sense of self collapsed.
After the $$超時空修復$$ she loses her memories of the fighting, but begins working as a nurse once again.

76.DSCR:
The 51st super long-range emigrant fleet.
The home of $$シェリル・ノーム$$, known as the '$$銀河の妖精$$'.
Like the $$マクロス・フロンティア船団$$, it is an emigrant fleet heading for a new land, sponsored by a private company, the '$$ゼネラルギャラクシー社$$'.
Its technological strength is among the top in the entire galaxy, and it developed technologies that make humans semi-mechanical, such as $$インプラント|lc$$s and cybernetics. Citizens who have undergone $$インプラント|lc$$ conversion live in an environment where reality and the virtual overlap.
On the other hand, it is a harsh living environment for flesh-and-blood humans who have not been implanted, and because of the social system and other factors slums also exist, presenting a distinctive aspect not seen in the other fleets.
76.DSC2:
The 51st super long-range emigrant fleet.
The home of $$シェリル・ノーム$$, known as the '$$銀河の妖精$$'.
Like the $$マクロス・フロンティア船団$$, it is an emigrant fleet heading for a new land, sponsored by a private company, the '$$ゼネラルギャラクシー社$$'.
Its technological strength is among the top in the entire galaxy, and it developed technologies that make humans semi-mechanical, such as $$インプラント|lc$$s and cybernetics. Citizens who have undergone $$インプラント|lc$$ conversion live in an environment where reality and the virtual overlap.
On the other hand, it is a harsh living environment for flesh-and-blood humans who have not been implanted, and because of the social system and other factors slums also exist, presenting a distinctive aspect not seen in the other fleets.
Although it was devastated by a $$バジュラ$$ attack, a device housing the bodies of the fleet's executives, together with operatives, infiltrated the $$フロンティア船団$$ and worked behind the scenes.

77.DSCR:
A series of battles between humanity and the $$プロトデビルン$$ that broke out centered on the $$マクロス７船団$$.
The fighting began when the $$バロータ軍$$ attacked the $$マクロス７船団$$ in order to gather $$スピリチア$$, the bioenergy of humans, which is food for the $$プロトデビルン$$.
Influenced by the song of $$熱気バサラ$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$ evolved into a species that regenerates $$スピリチア$$ by itself, so the reason for fighting disappeared and the war came to an end. Afterward, the $$プロトデビルン$$ left the Milky Way.

78.DSCR:
An interstellar war fought between Earth's humanity and the $$ゼントラーディ$$.
During the fighting, part of the $$ゼントラーディ$$ camp came into contact with Earth's culture, beginning with the songs of $$リン・ミンメイ$$, and lost the will to fight from culture shock.
When the $$ゼントラーディ$$'s $$ブリタイ$$ fleet then formed an alliance with the Earthlings, the $$ゼントラーディ$$ side's command fell into disorder, and it finally became a war between $$ボドルザー$$, who tried to destroy culture, and those who opposed him.
Through the '$$ミンメイ・アタック$$', an enemy-confusion operation using $$リン・ミンメイ$$'s songs, the war ended in victory for the Earth side, and the Earthlings and the $$ゼントラーディ$$ came to walk the path of coexistence.
Stories based on this great war have been made into visual works several times, in the $$マクロス７船団$$ and elsewhere, and $$リン・ミンメイ$$, who led the war to its end, has become a legendary idol singer as a great figure in history.

79.DSCR:
Beings born when energy life forms possessing will took possession of the group of biological weapons called the '$$エビル・シリーズ$$', created by the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
They feed on $$スピリチア$$, the bioenergy of humans, and the $$プロトカルチャー$$ is said to have been destroyed by the $$プロトデビルン$$.
They were sealed by the $$プロトカルチャー$$ 500,000 years ago, but awoke under the influence of Earth's humanity, which keeps increasing on a galactic scale, and this led to the start of the $$バロータ戦役$$.
79.DSC2:
Beings born when energy life forms possessing will took possession of the group of biological weapons called the '$$エビル・シリーズ$$', created by the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
They feed on $$スピリチア$$, the bioenergy of humans, and the $$プロトカルチャー$$ is said to have been destroyed by the $$プロトデビルン$$.
They were sealed by the $$プロトカルチャー$$ 500,000 years ago, but awoke under the influence of Earth's humanity, which keeps increasing on a galactic scale, and this led to the start of the $$バロータ戦役$$.
Influenced by the song of $$熱気バサラ$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$ evolved into a species that regenerates $$スピリチア$$ by singing songs themselves. The need to 'absorb $$スピリチア$$' disappeared.

80.DSCR:
A civilization that flourished far more than 500,000 years ago.
Because they were the first species among the life forms inhabiting space to possess culture, they named themselves '$$プロトカルチャー$$'.
They possessed great technological power, creating the $$ゼントラーディ$$ and the $$メルトランディ$$ at the end of an interstellar war. Later they created the group of biological weapons called the '$$エビル・シリーズ$$' as a still further weapon, but the $$プロトデビルン$$, born when spiritual energy from another dimension took possession of the $$エビル・シリーズ$$, drove them to extinction except for a few.
Their ruins remain on planets in various parts of space.

81.DSCR:
Giant combat soldiers created by the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
They fought Earth's humanity in the $$第一次星間大戦$$, and coming into contact with Earth's culture during that fighting became the opportunity for mutual understanding to advance and for the path to coexistence to open.
They are normally giants 10 m tall, but by using a '$$マイクローン装置$$' they can shrink to '$$マイクローン$$' size, an Earthling size of about 1.8 m, and can also return from there to their original giant size.
In the $$マイクローン$$ state, interbreeding with Earthlings is possible, and $$マックス$$ and $$ミリア$$, who became the first married couple of an Earthling and a $$ゼントラーディ$$ in history, had many children, including $$ミレーヌ$$.
They have their own language, and there are words that have taken root in Earth languages, beginning with '$$デ・カルチャー$$', which expresses amazement.

82.DSCR:
A group of biological weapons built by the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
They were more powerful than the giant combat soldiers '$$ゼントラーディ$$', which the $$プロトカルチャー$$ had also created, but during test operation, energy life forms possessing will that appeared from the $$サブ・ユニバース$$ took possession of them, turning them into the '$$プロトデビルン$$' and making them bare their fangs at the $$プロトカルチャー$$.

83.DSCR: A planet discovered and named by the $$マクロス５船団$$ in the S1350N3605 sector near the center of the Milky Way. A lush green planet resembling Earth, it holds the sleeping ruins of the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
83.DSC2: A planet discovered and named by the $$マクロス５船団$$ in the S1350N3605 sector near the center of the Milky Way. A lush green planet resembling Earth, it held the sleeping ruins of the $$プロトカルチャー$$, but it was engulfed in the self-destruction of $$ギギル$$, one of the $$プロトデビルン$$, and vanished.

84.DSCR:
The handle name used when posting to the site '$$オカルトフォーラム$$' on the $$ＵＮ$$.
It was originally a nickname given to him by his older sister, and carries her wish that he become a strong man who could protect himself.

proofread.reason: mistranslation/addition: the Japanese says 自分を守れる (protect oneself; 自分 refers back to the man the wish is about) and names no one else; 'protect her' (the sister) was an inference from the nickname

85.DSCR:
Her full name is $$グレイス・オコナー$$.
She was formerly $$シェリル$$'s manager, a woman of consummate skill who always wore a composed smile and effortlessly handled everything from scheduling to babysitting $$シェリル$$.
Her body has been fitted with cybernetic '$$インプラント|lc$$s' that are illegal within the $$フロンティア船団$$, granting her functions such as the ability to hack into network lines.

86.DSCR:
A term used by the $$プロトデビルン$$ to refer to high-dimensional energy and its possessor.
In the past, it is said that the one who sealed the $$プロトデビルン$$ on the ice planet was a possessor of this $$アニマスピリチア$$, and its power has properties directly opposite to $$スピリチア$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$'s energy source, dealing them damage.
The $$プロトデビルン$$ regarded $$熱気バサラ$$ of $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ as a threat, believing him to be an $$アニマスピリチア$$.

87.DSCR:
A mysterious cosmic ray that pours down from space.
Dr. $$早乙女$$ discovered it and succeeded in collecting it.
Many of its details remain unknown at present, but from the words of $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ it came to light that the $$インベーダー#robot$$ seek $$ゲッター線$$ in order to evolve.

88.DSCR:
The loss of super-abilities by a $$トップレス$$ as they grow older.
When the ability has been completely lost, it is said that they have 'reached $$あがり$$'.
The $$トップレス$$ ability reaches its maximum in adolescence, then gradually declines as the person approaches adulthood and is eventually lost.
88.DSC2:
The loss of super-abilities by a $$トップレス$$ as they grow older.
When the ability has been completely lost, it is said that they have 'reached $$あがり$$'.
The $$トップレス$$ ability reaches its maximum in adolescence, then gradually declines as the person approaches adulthood and is eventually lost.
Losing the $$トップレス$$ ability and no longer being able to continue as a $$バスターマシン$$ pilot is a source of terror for the $$トップレス$$ themselves, and the $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$ took various measures to avoid $$あがり$$.

89.DSCR:
A being that seeks to wipe out every lifeform possessing $$螺旋力$$.
Using $$ニア$$ as a $$メッセンジャー$$, it declared that it would bring despair upon humanity and attempted to drop the moon onto the Earth, but the plan was thwarted thanks to the efforts of $$シモン$$ and his friends.
Afterward, it confronted $$シモン$$ and his friends directly in the $$隔絶宇宙$$, but was defeated, and entrusted the future of the universe to them.

uncertain: kw 71: gender. The Japanese never says whether the Head Wing is she or he; I kept Jigoku's 'she' (and 'betrothed', 許婚) because the entry is about a known character with a pilot entry. Please confirm.

kw 71: Jigoku wrote 'winged ones' and 'guardian winged ones' as plain text; I made 天翅 / 聖天翅 / 守護天翅 tokens (Wing / Holy Wing / Guardian Wing) so they match the glossary's 堕天翅 = Fallen Wing. If the orchestrator wants 'winged ones', change the proposed English once.
kw 71: アポロニアス has both #keyword and #pilot tokens; I used #pilot because it is a person referenced in narrative. Jigoku English was 'Apollonius'.

kw 71: アトランディア大戦, ベクタールナ, 生命の樹, 創聖合体, バロン are not in the glossary; proposed English is from memory of Aquarion (Atlandia War, Vector Luna, Tree of Life, Divine Union, Baron). Spellings of Atlandia and Vector Luna are unverified.

kw 70: 人類銀河同盟 proposed as 'Galactic Alliance of Humankind' and イボルバー as 'Evolver' from memory of Gargantia, not from the local wikis. The DSC2 sentence 環境が激変した地球から旅立った人類を祖先に持ち... has an unstated subject; I read it as the alliance (the entry subject) having those ancestors and having opposed イボルバー, whose members turned into the Hideauze.
kw 70/85/76: ヒディアーズ is ambiguous (#keyword vs #robot); I used #keyword (the entry 39 for the life form). 'Hideauze' is the official English of the robot token, so both agree.

kw 84: 自分を守れる is ambiguous (protect himself vs protect the speaker, the older sister). I read 自分 as the wisher (the sister) given the nickname 'Knight', so the English says 'protect her'. Also 姉 was rendered 'his older sister', and the referent is a male (男) from the source; the Japanese does not say whose sister.
